_doc: Units check-cg and check-ngd each measure alone under CCV_HEAVY_SERIAL, on by default in every gate (DA, 2026-11-01 for CI, 2026-11-02 for local gates; CCV_HEAVY_SERIAL=0 turns it off): a heavy unit holds the lock exclusive, every other unit shared, so nothing runs beside it. Kept after the ROB split (OA-24) as future-proofing (DA, 2026-11-02); the full-size ooe_rob it was built for (Yosys and ABC 10.7 GB together) is gone. light_rss_max_mib: with the lock on, a unit not named here whose one command peaks over this fails the check; each command's own peak, measured through tools/rss-run.py (eda9ce8). 2048 MiB: four light units at once stay well within a 16 GB runner.

units.ooe_rob_w: one warp's ooe_rob_w (OA-24, the ROB split; the full-size ooe_rob it replaced peaked at 7514 MiB): check-cg peaked at 2324 MiB on a clean full gate (synth-cache cleared), over the light limit; check-ngd 1914 MiB (gate e35c9f9, 2026-11-02; DA: named here). Measured before eda9ce8, so it may include check-cg's own size; re-read at the first gate with both
units.ooe_rename: ooe_rename: listed from check-cg's 2662 MiB on CI run 551, which counted check-cg's own size; its own peak is 1014 MiB in check-cg and 650 MiB in check-ngd (f53fe58). Comes off with the ooe_rob split's retune (OA-24)
units.ooe_sched: ooe_sched: its bench build (OI's ooe_core.cpp at -O2, with the scheduler trio) peaked at 2190 MiB in check-cg, the first gate measuring each command's own peak (f53fe58, 2026-11-02), just over the light limit; revisit with the ooe_rob split (OA-24), when the limits are retuned
